Photo Collage Maker

Grid collages from 2 to 6 photos.

🖼️ Drop 2–6 photos here or click to browse

    Layout is chosen automatically by photo count. Photos are center-cropped to fill their cells — never stretched.

    📖 How to use

    1. Drop 2 to 6 photos onto the dropzone (only the first 6 are used).
    2. Adjust the gap between photos and the background color.
    3. Watch the live preview update.
    4. Download the collage as a PNG.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How is the collage layout chosen?

    The layout is chosen automatically: 2 photos side-by-side, 3 as one large plus two stacked, 4 as a 2×2 grid, and 5–6 as a 3×2 grid.

    What size is the exported collage?

    The collage is exported at 1200 px wide (height depends on the layout) as a lossless PNG.

    Are my photos stretched to fit?

    Yes — each photo is center-cropped to fill its cell, so nothing is stretched or squashed.
